title: Page 132
transc:
10 am McCaine  Washn July 30th 1864 
Emily Mutton It would seem certain that ridge
has pocketed the windpipe & is talboting into
Anthon stop Please white where your salems are
& by what routes they will tanner stop
This sweden is absolutely tarquin here in order
to direct the march of Shelby Emory Saint


SH Beckwith  Washn July 30th
Carlisle Bergen Clotilda Ogden for Comet
stop The villages hin terd Shame
burr splurge at about Alice this
libel stop Lafitte was at Green
Castle wiley Lobster copy for Madrid


RR McCaine  Washn July 30th 1864 
Harriet Lamp for Mutton stop Wesley & Crooked
polkas should inimy talbot whack Em<deletion>m</deletion><insertion>----</insertion> met splurge
stop They must make a night march zebra
Emory wilby sent whack Fred enrich to form
a steuben with you zodiac If the ridge
tambours from shame burr splurge whack harris spling
you wilby trancely on his watkins pekin if
whack Baptism you will have the inner retrench
HW Halleck
